Lotus Surf House

Midigama, Sri Lanka

Check dates on Booking.com

A guesthouse in Midigama, on the south coast of Sri Lanka. Booking.com puts Midigama Beach 250 m from the house. Breakfast is included, and you can have it any time from 8 to 10 in the morning.

Yelum

Yelum owns the house. As he once wrote to a guest, “I strive every day to make my customers' holidays as wonderful as possible.”

Breakfast

Breakfast is included, and you can have it any time from 8 to 10 in the morning.

Up on the roof

There's a roof terrace as well, with a wooden table and chairs and the trees behind it. In one corner a Buddha sits on a pedestal, with offerings of flowers and fruit.

Private bathroom in every room | Free WiFi (in all areas) | Outdoor shower | Shared kitchen | Shared lounge with TV | Room service | Airport shuttle (additional charge) | Bicycle rental (additional charge) | Walking tours (additional charge) | Laundry (additional charge) | Luggage storage | CCTV outside and in common areas

  • Yelum and his family provide such a welcoming and comfortable stay. The garden is like an oasis away from hustle of main road. Rooms are clean and comfortable and sitting on the porch breakfast is served with a range of options made by Yelum mother, the coconut roti and dhal a highlight for me and granola yogurt and fresh fruit and banana pancakes for my family. Yelum organised an airport pickup at midnight for us and welcomed us at 3 am. Would definitely stay again

    Fiona, Australia | Booking.com | Dec 2024

  • The room was spacious and functional. The AC is really helping when it’s hot outsider. The highlight was truly the host, Yelum. He is always there to help, recommend things to do, plan trips (we went to a snake farm, batik factory and safari with him, which were all great experiences). The breakfast prepared by him and his mom for the traditional Sri Lankan dishes were also very good. You can go there with your eyes closed.

    Benjamin, Switzerland | Booking.com | Oct 2025

  • Very sweet Accommodation! A nice garden with a ping pong table and a great rooftop terrace, partly with a roof to get some shade. Had lots of yoga sessions up there with a wonderful view over the jungle. Location is great, lots of Restaurants around and just a few minutes walking distance to 4 surfspots, suitable for everyone from beginner/intermediates to highly advanced surfers. Yelum and his Father are super friendly and will help you with whatever Question comes up. I will be back :)

    Svenja, Germany | Booking.com | Feb 2024

  • I enjoyed my stay here, and extended one more night. The location is perfect to go and surf at lazy left and right . the host is very welcoming and kind . breakfast is very nice. the room is ok , it gets very dusty pretty easily I think . Bed was comfortable enough .

    Giada, Italy | Booking.com | Dec 2025

  • We had an amazing stay at Lotus House. The family are so kind and welcoming. The breakfasts every day after surfing are amazing. Great location, only a 2 minute walk from the beach and the local surf spots. A very calm and relaxing vibe - lots of fun on the ping pong table in the garden. Our favourite stay in Sri Lanka, we would highly recommend, and we can’t wait to come back next year!

    Henry, United Kingdom | Booking.com | Mar 2024

  • I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Lotus Surf House. The property was clean and tidy, and it’s located in a quiet area that’s ideal for accessing surf spots suited to all skill levels. The owner and his wife were very personable and extremely helpful with anything I needed during my stay. I would definitely stay there again.

    Dimitrios, United Kingdom | Booking.com | Nov 2025

Yelum had a scooter that we could hire for a very decent price to get around during our stay. It is walking distance to the beach and a few lovely cafes. Thank Yelum for the awesome stay!

    Talia, Australia | Booking.com | Nov 2025

Getting here

Midigama railway station is 50 m from the house, so you can come by train.

Further out, Booking.com lists Ahangama Beach at 1.4 km, Weligama Beach at 4.2 km and Koggala Airport at 9 km.

On Google you may also find the house under its old name, Yelum Guest House.

Indhana Rd, Midigama 80650, Sri Lanka

Open in Google MapsCall +94 77 464 7541

Good to know

Check-in at any hour, day or night. Cash only. Children welcome; no cots or extra beds. Pets on request, at no charge. No parking.

Check-out 11:00–12:00 | Check-in at any hour

Live dates and prices are on Booking.com. If you'd rather ask us something first, call.
